## Week 1

**[From an idea to a word](slides/w1-griffin-ferreira.qmd)** &middot; Sep 3

Griffin & Ferreira (2006), up to section 1.3. The three steps of production,
why word selection and sound assembly are separate, and Properties 1 to 8. With
three experiments run live on the room: picture description, picture and word
interference, and tip of the tongue.
